title: Account for stale keep-alive and pinned clients before retirement
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Keep the old destination usable until each required keep-alive, synthetic routing-cookie, and admitted-work dependency is accounted for; distinguish fresh admission from retirement readiness.
preconditions: A modern browser with standard local HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no server or account.
Four fixed synthetic client checks: fresh-1, keepalive-1, pinned-1, and work-1.
One old keep-alive connection, one routing-cookie pin, and one admitted old work item initially require the usable old destination.
Each client contributes once to the four-client denominator; unknown started outcomes are never excluded.
actions: Choose reconnect or stale connection, rebind or stale pin, finish or pending work, verified or missing final work receipt, and guarded or forced retirement.
Route fresh arrivals to candidate without erasing old dependencies.
Resolve according to configured choices and inspect the per-client dependency viewer.
Request retirement; known or unverified dependencies block guarded retirement.
Check a prediction separately from user impact, retain another attempt, or explicitly reset.
assertions: Fresh candidate traffic alone is not evidence that old traffic/work is accounted for.
Each unresolved keep-alive, routing pin, or admitted-work dependency independently keeps the old destination usable.
Forced retirement turns each still-required client into one interruption, not success.
A claimed finish without its final work receipt is unknown; known pending work cannot be hidden by missing evidence.
Known interruption takes precedence over unknown evidence; all four clients remain attributed.
Safe abort, synthetic success, failure and unknown remain distinct from the prediction verifier and cleanup.
Inputs, phase transitions, locked configuration and immutable state are guarded.
Six complete results are retained without pruning until explicit reset or page reload.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine loadable-stub behavioral RED and before implementation.
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no infrastructure, cloud, identity registration, scaffold, deployment or spending is authorized.

limits: All clients, dependencies, routing and receipts are deterministic synthetic fixtures.
No actual cookie, authentication, connection, keep-alive protocol, traffic migration or Azure operation occurs.
No identities, tokens, keys, credentials, accounts or registration are introduced.
No elapsed-time, concurrency, capacity, platform or five-nines claims.
In-memory history is bounded and lost on explicit reset or page reload.
The published helper's known overall lifecycle deadline limitation is not solved or certified here.
B-S050 and D-S050 remain uncompleted native/source-parent work.
One frozen S unit; tests, evidence, and plumbing earn no extra credit.
